description: The Dominion tightens its hold on the Alpha Quadrant as Klingon conflict gives way to a larger war, Sisko faces the Maquis and Bajoran prophecy, and Cardassia makes a fateful alliance.

s05e01.description: Sisko leads an undercover team into Klingon territory to expose the Changeling believed to be impersonating Chancellor Gowron.

s05e02.description: A crashed Jem'Hadar vessel becomes the center of a tense standoff as both sides refuse to reveal what they value inside it.

s05e03.description: Worf coaches Quark in Klingon courtship while his own feelings for Dax become increasingly difficult to ignore.

s05e04.description: Jake experiences frontline warfare firsthand when he and Bashir are trapped at a Federation hospital under Klingon attack.

s05e05.description: An alien entity possesses Keiko and forces O'Brien to carry out a precise technical scheme under threat of her death.

s05e06.description: A temporal incident sends Defiant's crew into Kirk's encounter with tribbles, where they must stop an old Klingon enemy from changing history.

s05e07.description: A holiday on Risa turns political when Worf becomes sympathetic to activists who believe Federation society has grown dangerously complacent.

s05e08.description: Sisko, Dax, Odo and Garak awaken on occupied Terok Nor inside a memory of a case that exposes a dark choice from Odo's past.

s05e09.description: Odo and Quark crash on an inhospitable planet and must cooperate to carry a transmitter up a mountain before they freeze.

s05e10.description: Visions lead Sisko to the lost city of B'hala and a prophetic warning that could alter Bajor's planned entry into the Federation.

s05e11.description: Members of Kira's old resistance cell are murdered one by one by someone seeking revenge for their actions during the Occupation.

s05e12.description: Odo tries to raise an infant Changeling while Kira goes into labor with the O'Briens' child.

s05e13.description: Sisko pursues Michael Eddington across the Demilitarized Zone and adopts increasingly extreme tactics to force the former officer into the open.

s05e14.description: A message from the Gamma Quadrant reveals long-missing prisoners and exposes a Dominion infiltration reaching into the heart of the Alpha Quadrant.

s05e15.description: A Dominion fleet approaches while prisoners in the Gamma Quadrant attempt escape and Cardassia makes a decision that transforms the war.

s05e16.description: The creator of the Emergency Medical Hologram chooses Bashir as a model and inadvertently exposes the doctor's illegal genetic enhancement.

s05e17.description: Odo falls for a woman being hunted by the Orion Syndicate and discovers her identity is tied to a dangerous undercover operation.

s05e18.description: Quark enters the arms trade to escape debt and discovers that profitable abstraction feels different when the casualties become real.

s05e19.description: A dying Cardassian dissident comes to Kira for a final family ritual, forcing her to revisit memories of her own father's death.

s05e20.description: Quark returns home and discovers his mother is secretly involved with Grand Nagus Zek, making family and Ferengi politics equally uncomfortable.

s05e21.description: Worf and Dax join Martok aboard a Klingon ship whose demoralized crew has lost faith in both victory and its captain.

s05e22.description: Defiant's crew encounters descendants created by their own future crash and must decide whether returning home will erase an entire society.

s05e23.description: Sisko needs imprisoned Michael Eddington's help to stop a final Maquis strike that could kill millions on Cardassia.

s05e24.description: A salvage mission to an abandoned Cardassian station awakens soldiers conditioned to hunt anyone who enters.

s05e25.description: Jake and Nog chase an eccentric collector's demands to obtain a baseball card for Sisko as war anxiety settles over the station.

s05e26.description: Sisko mines the wormhole against Dominion reinforcements, triggering the assault on DS9 that begins open war.
